ns2:course.label: Research Project I
ns2:course.description: In this lecture/discussion course, students will work in groups, each led by a faculty mentor. Each group will develop a research question, design experiments to answer the question, and write a project proposal. No graduate credit. 2 professional hours. Approved for S/U grading only. Prerequisite: Good standing in the veterinary curriculum.
